identity.currencyHint: A three-letter ISO 4217 code. It locks once the store has products, orders, coupons or shipping methods.
identity.cultureHint: Visitors see this language first; more can be enabled in branding.
identity.createsClosed: The store is created as “Being set up”: closed to visitors, without a domain or administrator. Nothing is public until you activate it.

problem.nameControl: The name contains characters that aren't allowed.
problem.slugInvalid: {{min}}–{{max}} lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens, not at the start or end.
problem.slugReserved: “{{slug, bidi}}” is reserved by the platform.
problem.slugTaken: Another store already uses this slug.
problem.currencyInvalid: Enter a three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.
problem.timeZoneInvalid: Enter a time zone name such as Asia/Amman or UTC.
problem.hostNoPort: Enter the domain only — no https://, port or path.
problem.hostInvalid: This isn't a valid domain name.
problem.hostDuplicate: This domain is already on this store.

readiness.title: Ready for handover?
readiness.hint: What the store has, read from the server. Nothing here blocks activation; it tells you what is missing.

domain.label: Primary domain
domain.missing: The store has no domain, so no one can reach it.

domainVerified.label: Domain confirmed
domainVerified.attention: Not yet marked verified after DNS was set up.

admin.label: Store administrator
admin.done: An administrator has accepted the invitation.
admin.blocked: An invitation needs a domain: its link opens on the store's own domain.

status.label: Open to visitors
status.missing: Still being set up — closed to visitors.

profile.title: Profile
profile.currencyHint: The store's currency is the platform's decision; it locks once the store has any commercial activity.

domains.title: Domains
domains.hint: The hosts this store answers on. The first becomes primary; invitations and links use the primary domain.
domains.primaryLocked: Make another domain primary before removing this one.
domains.addHint: For example shop.client.com. DNS must point to the platform; verification is confirmed by hand.

done.primary: {{host, bidi}} is now the primary domain

verify.title: Mark {{host, bidi}} as verified?
verify.message: Confirm only after checking that the domain's DNS points to the platform. The platform does not check this automatically yet.

remove.title: Remove {{host, bidi}}?
remove.message: The store stops answering on this domain immediately. Links and bookmarks that use it will stop working.

modules.title: Modules
modules.hint: Optional capabilities. A disabled module is refused by the server, not only hidden.

description.promotions: Discount codes at checkout, managed by the store.
description.reviews: Verified buyers review products; the store moderates them.

admins.title: Administrator
admins.hint: The client's first administrator. They choose a password from an emailed link and then invite their own team.
admins.needsDomain: Add a domain before inviting an administrator: the invitation link opens on the store's own domain.
admins.archived: An archived store cannot receive new administrators.
admins.linkHost: The invitation link will open on {{host, bidi}}.
admins.renewed: A new invitation was sent to {{email, bidi}}; the previous link no longer works

current.Provisioning: Being set up: closed to visitors until activated.
current.Suspended: Suspended: closed to visitors. Its data is kept and it can be reactivated.
current.Archived: Archived: permanently closed. This cannot be undone.

Activate.title: Activate {{name, bidi}}?
Activate.message: The storefront opens to visitors on its domains immediately.

Suspend.title: Suspend {{name, bidi}}?
Suspend.message: The storefront closes immediately and shows a store-unavailable page. Data is kept, and the store can be reactivated.

Archive.title: Archive {{name, bidi}}?
Archive.message: The store closes permanently and cannot be reactivated. Its data is kept for the record.

warning.domain: It has no domain, so visitors cannot reach it yet.
warning.admin: No administrator has accepted an invitation, so no one can run it yet.

store.settingsSubtitle: The same editor the store's administrator uses. Changes apply to the storefront when saved.

accounts.title: Platform accounts
accounts.subtitle: Who can sign in to this console, and with which role. Store teams are managed inside each store.
accounts.inviteHint: They receive an email with a link to choose a password, on this platform address. Inviting a pending address again sends a fresh link and replaces the earlier one.

roleHint.PlatformAdmin: Runs stores (create, set up, suspend, archive), reads platform statistics and the activity log. Cannot manage platform accounts.
roleHint.PlatformOwner: Everything an administrator can do, and manages platform accounts — including other owners.

accounts.inviteRenewed: A fresh invitation link was sent to {{email, bidi}}.
accounts.disabled: {{name, bidi}} was disabled and signed out.

confirmDisable.title: Disable {{name, bidi}}?
confirmDisable.message: They are signed out of the platform console immediately and can't sign in until enabled again. The last active owner can't be disabled.

accounts.emptyMessage: Invite someone to help run the platform.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.subtitle: Who did what, in which store, and when — newest first.

scope.summary: What this log does and doesn't contain
scope.recorded: Every administrative request that succeeded: in this console and in every store's back office, including some reads.
scope.notRecorded: Not recorded: requests that were refused, invalid or failed; sign-ins and sign-outs; and shoppers' own actions. An action missing from this log is not proof it never happened.
scope.identity: Entries name the account and the store by number, with the account's role — names are not part of the record.
scope.selfRecorded: Opening or filtering this log is itself recorded.
scope.timeZone: Times are shown in your browser's time zone; the exact UTC instant is in each entry's details.

filter.storeHint: The number in a store's address, e.g. /platform/stores/12.
filter.actionHint: A category includes every activity under it.

problem.actionTooLong: Too long to be an activity code.
problem.rangeReversed: The end date is before the start date.

audit.emptyMessage: Entries appear here as soon as someone changes something.
audit.noMatchMessage: Widen the dates, or clear a filter.

action.tenant_settings_updated: Store settings changed from the platform
action.tenant_branding_uploaded: Branding file uploaded from the platform
action.tenant_payments_updated: Store payment account set from the platform
action.tenant_payments_removed: Store payment account unlinked from the platform

audit.noMetadata: This entry recorded no further details.
